decisions.reason: The client explicitly selects the 0.82-inch spine width for the separate D2D cover; the Amazon-specific cover remains governed by its existing 0.90-inch specification.
Selecting the D2D template and spine width does not change the required title-font consistency across cover panels.
The source specifies the D2D cover template and spine width but does not add, remove, or change any required deliverable format.
The D2D spine-width decision does not alter the established blurb reflow or barcode-clearance rule.
The source does not change the tagline text, its expected rendering, or the required font-portability method.
Proceeding with a separate D2D cover using its template is compatible with, and does not modify, the existing no-redesign constraint.
The D2D cover specification does not affect Amazon PDF upload acceptance or the existing file-size optimization requirement.
